scope: Technical GPX availability and edition-specific status for top-level events 111–120 in current EVENTS order
safety: Existing GPX files remain valid as fallback until an official replacement is actually downloaded, parsed and validated.
Do not delete, overwrite or replace any historical GPX file during this audit.
A map panel, GPX button, third-party listing or direct link does not count as binary validation.
Do not fetch, store, mirror, process or display route GPX where organizer restrictions, private-land access conditions or rights remain unclear.

events.name: Austria Backyard Ultra 24+1 Hochkönig

technicalAttempt.result: No binary endpoint available to test. Official page gives route narrative but its dedicated route/map section is still a placeholder.

events.detail: The loop starts/finishes at ONKEL LENZ Clubhouse, passes Maria Alm village square and the golf course, includes an approximately 250m/60hm steep rise, then uses gravel/forest paths and returns on asphalt. This 60hm segment is not the total loop ascent. No total elevation gain should be inferred.
events.rightsNote: No GPX file found; no route file imported or copied.

events.name: Megamarsch München
events.startLocation: Wiesenfläche an der Eichthalstraße, 81547 München, Deutschland

technicalAttempt.result: Official page says route will be available as a Komoot download approximately two weeks before the event. The course is provisional and may be changed after a final bicycle inspection two days before the event.

events.detail: The official page confirms 100km, approximately 990hm, four refreshment stations at roughly 20km intervals and a point-to-point route to Garmisch-Partenkirchen.
events.rightsNote: No Komoot route available to inspect yet; obtain and validate only after official release.

events.name: Vietnam Highlands Trail by UTMB
events.date: 2027-01-07/10; four official race distances on the entry page

additionalFormatCandidate.name: 5K Xuanhuong
additionalFormatCandidate.status: appears in prior event schedule research but is not listed among the four race distances on the current official entry page; do not insert as an official race route without clarification

technicalAttempt.result: The official 100K, 50K and 20K race pages display GPX download controls. The actual files were not fetched because the organizer explicitly warns that routes pass through private land and some sections require tickets or prior permission.

events.detail: Major correction to provisional earlier data: 100K page gives 101.5km/5722hm; 50K gives 54.6km/3106hm; 10K gives 10.6km/435hm. The 20K Pinhatt page is internally inconsistent: page heading 24.1km, race details table 22.8km, and the event overview/older checkpoint 22.2km. Keep all three values in a discrepancy note; do not silently overwrite the stored distance.
events.accessWarning: Official organizer warning: routes pass through tourist attractions and private land; some areas require an entry ticket or prior permission; route may not be fully prepared/safe outside race support; organizer strongly discourages running it outside the official event.
events.rightsNote: Do not mirror, store, display or redistribute these GPX files in the app pending explicit organizer permission and clarification of the private-land access conditions. A public download control does not grant third-party app reuse rights.
